column1: # Floors this pair is held to by hand (PRB-1607, PRB-1957, NOT-0228). compose takes a combination's floor before anything it measures or borrows; the merge refuses the composed rows under it, and the aligner rows under the line "aligner" (the pair's own model), before the competition (status refused-by floor). readings: the combination as a composed source names it after "aligned", or aligner. from: the confidence from which its links stand, or refused. right of scored: how often the links read at or above the floor were right (for a refused line, all of them read), bands weighted by rows.
